data_scope: Fold 0 training 200 only; validation IDs excluded
method: within each 26-connected lesion component, select the exact lowest intensity rank fraction on baseline nnUNet-preprocessed DWI
selection_rule: smallest audited percentile with hard voxels in every lesion-positive training case, median hard fraction >=18%, 10th-percentile hard-voxel count >=10, and mean within-lesion standardized easy-minus-hard separation >=0.5
